create_exp_op: create an ExpOp instance to extract experience entries with history and future slots from agent memory
extract_exp_op_entries: extract experience entries from a memory buffer using ExpOp.extract with a given sequence length T
create_batch_assembler: create a BatchAssembler to collect and batch experiences from multiple agents with configurable batch size and sequence length
feed_experience_to_assembler: feed a single experience dictionary into the BatchAssembler and optionally return a completed batch
get_batch_from_assembler: draw a batch of experiences from the BatchAssembler for training with optional incomplete batch support
